C1749.title: Detecting and Defending Against Data Poisoning Attacks on AI Models
C1749.summary: Experimental results show that data poisoning significantly degrades model performance, with classification accuracy dropping by up to 27% in image recognition tasks and 22% in fraud detection models. The proposed defense mechanisms, including statistical anomaly detection and adversarial training, successfully mitigated the poisoning impact.
